hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */source/*.js|*/source/*.css|*/source/build.cjs) d=${f%/source/*}; if [ -f "$d/source/build.cjs" ] && [ -f "$d/source/carve-reference.html" ]; then node "$d/source/build.cjs" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "ICARUS demo rebuild failed in $d" >&2; fi;; esac; exit 0
